name: Hiroyasu Tsukamoto
title: Assistant Professor (joined fall 2024); concurrent KAIST Visiting Professor
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with source-complete2026 learned flapping-wing flight, current own-group mentorship and a verified external master’s visitor precedent. A specific advertised summer intern role is closed; general2027 availability remains unknown.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full March 2026 Conformal Koopman paper learns neural lifting/decoding maps and latent dynamics for an actual Flapper Nimble+ drone, with a neural surrogate for offline calibration. The learned high-level controller supplies position targets to the manufacturer’s low-level PID; it is not an end-to-end neural flight controller. Actual motion-capture flight tracks0.5m-radius circles in several planes, with error-bound evaluation and comparison to default PID. Guarantees depend on calibration/exchangeability/model assumptions; they are not universal real-world safety guarantees. The paper’s first author Koki Hirano is listed in the current lab MS roster as a University of Tokyo visiting student, establishing directly supervised group work. Separate Dubins-car results are simulation; prior Caltech spacecraft testbeds are not credited as new UIUC hardware.
